def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    blocks = [(r, c) for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w - 1)
              if all(grid[i][j] == 0
                     for i in (r, r + 1) for j in (c, c + 1))]
    if not blocks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r, c = blocks[0]
    rows, cols = {r, r + 1}, {c, c + 1}
    return [[(v if v == 2 else 0) if i in rows or j in cols else v
             for j, v in enumerate(row)] for i, row in enumerate(grid)]
